description: Data-broker removal guidance and privacy-tool comparisons.
tagline: Get your personal information off data-broker sites.
image_alt: They Are Tracking — data-broker removal guidance and privacy-tool comparisons.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team researches and compares privacy tools and data broker removal processes.

editorial.how_we_test: We manually opt out of data brokers to verify the free process, and test paid removal services using test profiles to measure their effectiveness.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We earn an affiliate commission when you purchase some of the privacy tools or paid removal services we recommend. We disclose these relationships on the pages where they appear.
editorial.corrections: If we make an error in our methodology or a data broker changes their opt-out process, we update the guide and note the change at the top of the page.
